title: Print Hello World
description: Use print() to show Hello World on the screen. Write the words inside quotation marks.
hints: Write print() in the code area.
Put any message inside the brackets and quotes, for example print("Hello Python").
Click Run. Any message printed with valid print() code is accepted.
explanation: print() displays text or a value on the screen. Put text inside quotation marks. You can print your own name, a greeting, or any sentence. The example solution is only one possible answer.
commonMistakes: Check brackets and quotes, use the correct indentation, and make sure you actually use the Python feature asked for in the task.

validation.feedback: Use print(...) with any text or value. The exact words do not matter.

title: Write a comment

hints: Read the task once and identify the Python feature it asks you to practise.
Add a # comment and a working print(...) statement.
Write your own code, press Run, and fix any syntax or runtime error shown.
explanation: This task gives you practice with add a comment. The reference solution is only one example; other working approaches are accepted when they use the required Python feature.
commonMistakes: Check brackets and quotes, use the correct indentation, and make sure you actually use the Python feature asked for in the task.

validation.feedback: Add a # comment and a working print(...) statement.
